purpose: Asks a person when excluding a finding would move the dataset enough to change what a reader concludes; otherwise the screen's auto disposition applies.
data: Asks when any declared bar is reached: the finding's share of sessions, orders, revenue, or buying sessions, or the relative shift it causes in conversion or AOV. A bar set to null is not read. maxAutoMembers, when set, also asks when a finding has more members than that.
